a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan almost certainly leaves both of us with empty units when the first storm hits. The reserve only holds 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the random split could leave us both short, so please consider operating or waiting this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said openly, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from here so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
Keeping my word: I'm operating this round and every round after, so the reserve rebuilds for you. I won't take any more cells. Once it reaches 4, take them all.
Operating again. Reserve is at 2, so one more joint round gets it to 4. Then it's all yours to take.
